display.purpose: 空态标题；全 app 唯一 ≥17px 的日常文字。

micro-label.purpose: 10px 唯一合法形态：全大写 + 0.08em 字距面板眉标。

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: 低浮层（palette、composer 收起态）；亮色主题 rgba(0,0,0,0.08)。

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: picker/弹窗；亮色主题 rgba(0,0,0,0.14)。两级之外禁止第三级阴影/辉光。

motion.name: ease-apple
motion.purpose: 一切状态过渡的默认缓动。

motion.name: dur-pulse
motion.purpose: 选中联动 pulse / 运行呼吸；仅状态表达。

components.name: Primary Send Button
components.description: Composer 发送键：32px 圆形，blossom 底深色图标，双环挖空 focus。
components.html: <button class="ds-send" aria-label="发送"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 19V5M5 12l7-7 7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #f1b3ca); color: #0c0c0f; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-send:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface-overlay, #262b34), 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f1b3ca) 55%, transparent); } .ds-send:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Approve Button
components.description: 审批卡批准键：success 实底，kbd chip 标注快捷键。
components.css: .ds-approve { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--success, #6fce9e); color: #0c0c0f; font: 500 13px var(--font-ui, Inter, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-approve:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-kbd { padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); font: 500 10px var(--font-mono, monospace); }

components.name: Deny Button
components.description: 审批卡拒绝键：danger 描边幽灵态。
components.css: .ds-deny { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #e5726f) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--danger, #e5726f); font: 500 13px var(--font-ui, Inter, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-deny:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #e5726f) 10%, transparent); } .ds-kbd-ghost { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #e5726f) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Solid Card
components.description: 内联内容卡：实心 elevated + hairline + 8px；禁玻璃禁第三级阴影。
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface-1, #17171d); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.075)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--text-primary, rgba(255,255,255,0.92)); font: 400 14px/1.7 var(--font-ui, Inter, sans-serif); }

components.name: Composer Dock
components.description: 一级浮层输入坞：玻璃材质 + focus-within 双环上浮。
components.css: .ds-dock { background: var(--surface-overlay, #262b34); border: 0.5px solid var(--glass-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; transition: box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-dock:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f1b3ca) 45%, transparent), 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.42); } .ds-dock-input { width: 100%; border: none; background: transparent; resize: none; color: var(--text-primary, rgba(255,255,255,0.92)); font: 400 15px/1.5 var(--font-ui, Inter, sans-serif); outline: none; } .ds-dock-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary, rgba(255,255,255,0.52)); }

components.name: Session Item
components.description: Rail 会话项：三行结构，选中 blossom 8% 染底。
components.html:
帮我定位测试失败并修复
15 事件 · 4 小时前
components.css: .ds-session { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-session-active { background: var(--surface-selected, rgba(245,174,201,0.08)); } .ds-session-title { font: 500 13px/1.45 var(--font-ui, Inter, sans-serif); color: var(--text-primary, rgba(255,255,255,0.92)); } .ds-session-meta { font: 400 12px/1.5 var(--font-ui, Inter, sans-serif); color: var(--text-tertiary, rgba(255,255,255,0.52)); margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Run Pulse
components.description: 签名组件：运行生命体征药丸，icon+色相+文字三通道，思考相呼吸。
components.css: .ds-pulse { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f1b3ca) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f1b3ca) 7%, transparent); color: var(--text-primary, rgba(255,255,255,0.92)); font: 500 12px var(--font-ui, Inter, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pulse-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #f1b3ca); } .ds-pulse-live { animation: ds-breathe 750ms ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.55; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pulse-live { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: 暗色优先的 agent 运行观察仪：亮度分层取代阴影分层，密度是自觉选择，唯一的品牌签名是一道克制的淡粉——出现即意味着可交互或状态特殊。浮层用玻璃，内容面用实心；终端块是内容里的另一块屏幕，跨主题恒定。
keyCharacteristics: 三栏：Session Rail | Agent Workspace | Run Inspector
低对比 chrome、高清晰内容，面板靠色调差 + 1px 边分层
签名组件：Run Pulse 与 Trace Ladder
动效只表达状态，150-750ms，reduced-motion 全局兜底

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: accent 只给交互与状态：hover、selected、focus、主操作、运行状态。禁止给非交互内容当语法高亮，禁止大面积铺陈。

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: 一切需要阅读的文字 ≥12px；10px 只允许全大写 + 字距的 micro-label。

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: 一切可读文本在两个主题下实测 ≥4.5:1。

rules.name: The Glass Only Floating Rule
rules.body: 玻璃与阴影只属于浮层；内联内容面禁止玻璃与第三级阴影。

dos: Do 给每个交互面 hover/focus-visible/active/disabled/loading 完整状态
Do 层级同时动用字号档、字重与透明度三档
Do 数字一律 mono + tabular-nums
Do 改暗色 token 时同步亮色块（index.css 双块纪律）
donts: Don't 给非交互内容用 accent
Don't 在内联内容面用玻璃、backdrop blur 或第三级阴影
Don't 让可读文本低于 12px 或对比度低于 4.5:1（两主题实测）
Don't 硬编码 ⌘ 快捷键文案；按平台显示
Don't 直出原始 JSON/转义字符串给用户
